description: MIKE IO 1D is DHI's Python package for inspecting one-dimensional MIKE network results and cross sections. It reads res1d, res, resx, out and xns11 files, exposes reach discharge and node water-level series as data frames, and plots selected cross-section geometry. Users supply model files; the package has global applicability but no fixed network, observation period or spatial resolution. Source, examples and installation instructions are public and free under MIT. The documented environment is 64-bit Python 3.12–3.14 on Windows, with Linux support labelled experimental. Linux users require a separate .NET runtime, and development builds need the SDK. Those platform dependencies are material limits on immediate reuse. The reader does not replace the hydraulic solver or its licence. It supports model checking and calibration around MIKE+ (platform-dhi-mike-plus), while other MIKE multidimensional formats are handled by the separate MIKE IO package. This metadata review did not open any result file or verify numerical extraction.
